newsitem.title: UK: IPE natgas continues firmer in winter, spring trade.
newsitem.headline: IPE natgas continues firmer in winter, spring trade.

text.p: IPE natural gas futures prices continued firmer on Tuesday morning as January, April and May all saw trade at higher prices.
January saw a single 25-lot trade done at 18.10 pence a therm, up by 0.05 pence from Monday's settlement, while the same volume was traded in February at the same price.

A further 25 lots were traded in May at 11.10 pence, up 0.03 pence from Monday. And moments before the close of the morning session, a 15-lot deal was done in April at 12.00 pence, up by 0.035 pence a therm and bringing the total for the morning session to 90 lots in four deals.

IPE futures volumes have picked up significantly over last week and this, with dealers on the OTC market saying that IPE bid/offer spreads have corresponded closely to the OTC market in many periods as liquidity has increased.
Front month August bucked the firmer trend, bid at 9.60 pence a therm by the close and offered at 9.75 pence, below the previous settlement price of 9.79 pence.
